character_facts: General Thato obeys or is expected to obey summary execution orders.
The helmeted officials react with rage and contempt rather than debate.
The two Mentreks are desperate enough to argue for escape despite the risk.
One surviving Mentrek continues warning the court even after the shooting begins.
characters_present: Assembled officers, guards, and onlookers in the chamber
continuity_links: This page depicts an immediate military-political response to news of an approaching invasion fleet.
The mention of the Metacraft and the Pthaur(e)an fleet ties this scene to a larger wartime plot beyond the chamber.
dialogue_meaning: The ruling figures dismiss the suggested refuge as absurd and impossible.
Speaking this proposal is treated as insubordination or madness deserving immediate execution.
The Mentreks insist the strategic situation is hopeless without flight.
They warn that millions of Pthaur(e)an ships are already traveling through interstellar space.
The Metacraft is identified as leading the approaching force.
The enemy is said to be less than twenty-four hours from the empire's borders.
locations: An imperial chamber, tribunal, or council hall
lore_facts: The setting includes an Empire with defined borders.
There are beings or people called Mentreks.
General Thato holds authority over armed troops in this chamber.
A hostile force described as Pthaur(e)an has a fleet numbering in the millions.
Interstellar travel is routine enough for fleets to be actively traversing space.
A vessel or entity called the Metacraft leads the incoming fleet.
The page mentions bizarre worlds or environments at the universe's edge as examples of impossible refuges.
plot_events: Officials in an imperial gathering ridicule a desperate escape proposal by listing absurd worlds and conditions.
A superior orders General Thato to execute two Mentreks for voicing that proposal.
An armed soldier fires on the two Mentreks in the chamber.
At least one victim is hit and collapses amid blood and panic.
A surviving speaker pleads that there is no alternative because a massive enemy fleet is already on the way.
The page ends with the crowd demanding that the surviving speaker also be shot.
uncertainties: Several proper names are hard to read precisely from the page image, including 'Mentreks,' 'General Thato,' 'Pthaur(e)an,' and 'Metacraft.'
The exact institutional setting is not named on the page; it appears to be an imperial council or tribunal chamber.
The opening mocked destinations are only partially legible, so their exact wording is uncertain.
It is visually clear that one figure is shot; whether both Mentreks are hit on this page alone is uncertain.
visual_summary: A heated imperial assembly turns violent. Close-up panels show armored, helmeted officials angrily mocking a proposal involving fleeing to impossible places at the edge of the universe. In the larger chamber below, a commander orders General Thato to shoot two Mentreks for speaking such ideas. A black-armored soldier opens fire, blasting one pale, thin figure as another recoils. In the final panels, a kneeling survivor cries that there is no other solution because millions of enemy ships are already in interstellar transit with the Metacraft leading them and will reach the empire's borders within a day; the crowd responds with another order to kill him.
